name: Remix: Pragmatic Lexicon
description: Pragmatic Lexicon is a high-performance vocabulary and active-recall flashcard learning app tailored for software engineers, journalists, and professionals. Features 1,253 curated terms across letters A–Z spanning software architecture, AI/ML systems, broadcast journalism, and global diplomacy with dual English and Tamil context examples for every entry, comprehensive thesaurus explore, British English pronunciation, and interactive 3D study cards.
